mapper.select: /* Attd11Mapper.selectHalfLeaveWindows */ SELECT DISTINCT L.USER_CD AS userCd , L.START_DATE AS workYmd , L.START_TIME AS startTime , L.END_TIME AS endTime FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE L WHERE L.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND L.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND L.START_DATE LIKE CONCAT(REPLACE(#{workYm}, '-', ''), '%') AND L.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '01' AND L.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND L.DEL_YN = 'N' AND L.START_TIME IS NOT NULL AND L.END_TIME IS NOT NULL
